exploratory: Added on 6 November 2026 after every other result had been seen (PROTOCOL.md section 13); not confirmatory. Evo 2 is reported at 1% and below only.
fits: cross-validated (5-fold by person); locked: fitted on the 200 SNV cases under the same threshold
intervals: 1000 resamples of people per stratum, seed sha256('replication/<label>/<stratum>'), label main at 0.1%, bg1pct at 1%, sweep<threshold> otherwise
